title: ProspectingAgentExternalCompanyResearch - Data API
description: Represents research done by a prospecting agent on an external company.

ExternalIdentifier.description: The external ID associated with the lead or contact the AI agent researched.

IsQualified.properties: Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort

OwnerId.description: This field is a polymorphic relationship field.

Rationale.description: The explanation of why the account was qualified or not. The rationale provides extra context to guide human users in their decision making.

ResearchRunKey.description: The date and time the research was complete.

Source.description: The source of the external company.

special_access_rules: This object is available if Agentforce Prospecting is enabled in your org and your org has an Agentforce for Sales or an Agentforce for an Industry add-on license. To access this object, you need the Sales Agentic Prospecting Manager user permission.
